name: CapitulationDip - the drop-regime book
hypothesis: System 06 loses in drop regimes. A long-only capitulation dip-buyer earns in exactly those regimes, so a 06+07 combine raises the rolling one-year win rate without the median cost a breadth-gated single system pays.
mechanism: Per symbol: open long when the causal capitulation score exceeds `enter`; close on a bounce target, a stop, or a maximum horizon. Equal-fraction sizing, capped concurrent names, shared cash, 0.003 round trip.
data: 15m candles, the system 06 universe, via the shared catalogue
system 06's causal capitulation score as the entry feature

helped.what: A 30% cash sleeve of the capitulation book over the balanced trend book
helped.effect: every thin research year lifts (worst year 5.1% -> 7.6%) and combined drawdown falls in 6 of 8 years (2021 17.4% -> 10.8%) - the bounce-buyer earns inside the crashes that draw the trend book down
expectancy concentrates in deep flushes - the top drop quartile pays +3.89% per trade at 72% win

helped.what: Measuring the package through quantlab_system07.combine rather than by hand
helped.effect: package v2: worst year +8.3%, 2022 +17.7% at 3.5% drawdown, 2018 +41.3% at lower drawdown than the trend book alone, 2021 +1196.7% at 12.0%

hurt.what: Sizing the sleeve once at the start of the year
hurt.effect: overdraws cash in growth years; a monthly rebalance is the recorded fix and has not been done
hurt.evidence: e9c57a9, caveat recorded at the time

hurt.effect: overshoots - the same shape as every dose curve measured that week, which is why 0.5 was taken

open.what: Monthly rebalance of the cash sleeve
open.why: the year-start sizing is known to overdraw in growth years and the fix was deferred, not tested

open.what: A sealed reading of the combine
open.why: every number above is a research-era number; the package has never been read on a sealed year

rules: Two books beat one when their losses land in different regimes - the capitulation book earns inside the drawdowns that hurt the trend book, which is why the combine lifts the worst year rather than the median.
Dose curves in this laboratory overshoot at 1.0. Measure the response, take the half-dose, and do not assume more of a good lever is better.
A caveat recorded at the time of the measurement is worth more than one reconstructed later - the year-start cash overdraw was known on the day and is still the first thing to fix.

results.verdict: Workshop. Research-era evidence is strong and no sealed reading has been spent.
